highlights: The harvest watch no longer goes dark in the middle of September. It was keyed to a sowing-safety date rather than to frost, so every year it stopped flagging tender crops on 18 September — in ten of the last eleven seasons that was between two and six weeks before frost actually arrived. It now runs to the measured first-frost date.
Logging several care tasks in a row no longer buries Today under a pile of notifications. They stack in a fixed column, cap at three, and repeats of the same kind combine into one.
